(nga )༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /rgya gar dpal dus kyi 'khor lo lha

tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar

dpal dus kyi 'khor lo lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dus zhabs pas mdzad pa/ skad du/ shrī kā la tsakra sa hā dza sā dha na/ bod skad du/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// rab 'jigs 'jig rten kun skyob pa// bud med sbyor la tshangs par spyod// thugs rje shes rab dbyer med la// phyag 'tshal de sgrub mdo tsam bri// rab tu bsngags pa'i sa yi char sngags pa yid dge bas/ maṇḍal la sogs pa byas la/ gtor ma sbyin pa sngon du 'gro bas bgegs bskrad par bya'o// de nas bhrūm̐ las rdo rje'i khang pa brtsegs par bsams la/ dbus su 'dam skyes dang*/ nyi ma la hūm̐ rab tu dkar ba las 'od 'phros te/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa bkug nas/ mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par bya'o// stong pa dang rlung dang me dang chu dang sa dang*/ rgya mtsho ro padma zla ba nyi ma me dkyil du// rin chen khang brtsegs 'od 'phro bsgom// zla ba nyi ma me steng du// drag po 'dod lha'i gdan bzhugs pa// rdo rje dang ni dril 'dzin 'khyud// gangs ri ltar dkar btsun mor bcas// pha rol phyin drug dag pas brgyan// yon tan thams cad tshad med pas// tshad med dag pa'i chos ldan pa// sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid do// lte bar sangs rgyas yum bcas sreg /spyi bor zla ba bzang rgyun 'dzag /chos 'byung gnyis 'dus rdo rje can// srid gsum yongs dag bsgom par bya// rdo rje padma mnyam sbyor las// shes rab padmar sems thig le// lhan cig skyes pa bde dbang gis// mi shigs 'od gsal bsgom par 'gyur// bsnyen pas bdud rtsi lnga las sogs// rigs kyi gtso bo bzhi dag ni// sngags kyi bzlas pa la sogs pa// so sor sdud pa la sogs 'gyur// rdo rje padma las skyes pa'i// bdud rtsi nye bar sgrub pa'o// dga' ba la sogs rdo rje gsum// padmar mnyam song bsgrub par 'gyur// shes rab sbyor la mi 'dzag gang*// sgrub pa chen po nyid 'gyur te// phra mo yi ni sbyor bas so// de bzhin gzhan ni gzhan du 'gyur// mchog tu gsang ba khyab bdag las// rtse gcig mnyam par bzhag pas ni// thun mong thun mong ma yin rtags// smig rgyu nam mkha' la sogs mthong*// oṃ kā la tsakra āḥhūm̐ ho swā hā// oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ swā hā/

oṃ rdo rje dbyangs kyi dbang phyug ma badzra dhā twī shwa rī āḥhūṃ hoḥswā hā/ ting 'dzin las skyo na/ do li la sogs pa'i rnam pas bzla bar bya'o// nyi ma dang*/ zla ba dang*/ dus dang*/ ro dang*/ rgya mtsho dang*/ me dang*/ nam mkha'i de kho na nyid bsgom par bya'o// gtor ma ni mtshan phyed na sbyin par bya'o// dus dang ro'i yi ges byin gyis brlabs la/ rgya mtsho dang mig gi phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyin par bya'o// oṃ brahma tshangs pa/ biṣṇu khyab 'jug nai ri tya bden bral/ bā yu rlung lha ya ma gshin rje agni me lha sa mu dra rgya mtsho/ ī shwa ra dbang phyug ind+ra dbang po/ yakṣe bhyaḥ gnod sbyin/ 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ 'di gtong ma tshims par gyis/ gandhe dri puṣpe me tog dhū paṃ bdug spos dī paṃ sgron me akṣa taṃ mnyam pa da dā ma he bdag gis dbul gyis te tsa ā ga tya de rnams byon nas sa pa ri wā ra 'khor bcas shī ghraṃ myur du zungs i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇantu tṛ st+waṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra dha ra rdo rje 'chang gi ādzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ bka' bzhin gyis/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis so// nor mchog gtong ba sbyin pa ste// yum sbyor mi 'dzag tshul khrims so// dgra sogs mi 'jug bzod pa ste// g.yeng spong gnyis zer/ le lo med brtson 'grus// kun nas mi g.yeng bsam gtan mchog /bde sbyor 'od gsal shes rab yin// de 'bras bsam mi khyab rmad byung*// he ru ka dpal brjod pa'o// de ltar cung zad dus 'byung rgyud// snying po sbas pa 'di phyung bas// sgrub po yang dag sbyor rnams la// ye shes me chen 'bar bar 'gyur// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dus kyi zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// paṇḍi ta chen po buddha shrī dzñā na dang*/

lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o// ༈ /bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// na maḥshrī kā la tsakra ya/ gang 'dir gnyis med ye shes kyi// rigs brgya rnam dag dam pa'i dngos// rgyal ba drug 'dus rdo rje sems// dus kyis 'khor lo la 'dud do// 'dir dus 'khor lhan skyes bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bar bya/ shū n+ya tās stong bar sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang skad cig gis dus 'khor lhan skyes su gyur pa ni/ rlung me chu dang sa yi dkyil 'khor lhun po padma dang*// zla nyi dus me'i steng du dbang phyug dang ni bdud kyi mgor// zhabs ni srid pa'i yum gyi zhabs dang lhan cig bkod gyur pa// lha yi dbang pos btud pa'i gtso la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pas/ zhabs g.yon pa dkar po bskums pas dbang phyug dkar po dang*/ g.yas pa dmar po brkyangs pas 'dod lha dmar po'i snying ga mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang zla ba phyed pas dbu la brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i rgyan dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ mthe bong ser po/ mdzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ srin lag nag po/ mthe'u chung ljang gu/ phyag sor rnams kyi tshigs kyi phreng ba dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po'o// rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan cing me ri kha dog sna lnga pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de la 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pas yab dang sbyor ba/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing dbu skra phyed grol ba'o// gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/

lte bar hoḥser po/ gtsug tor du ham̐ ljang gu/ gsang bar kṣa sngon po rnams su gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho ham̐ kṣaḥzhes pa'o// snying gar rnam bcu dbang ldan brtsegs mar bsams nas/ oṃ ham̐ kṣa ma la wa ra ya swā hā/ zhes pa ci nus bzla/ thun mtshams su dge ba bsngo/ 'di la gtor bsngo sogs med kyang rung la/ spro na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥzhes byin gyis brlab/ sangs rgyas yab yum sras dang bcas pa g.yog 'khor dang*// grogs bcas gnyen rnams dag gis bskor ba'i tshogs pa ni// lha dang lha mo dag gis mnyes par byed rnams dang*// mchog gi rdo rje sems dpa' dag ni gshegs su gsol// zhes mdun du spyan drangs/ snying po'i mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ arghaṃ nas/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod la/ stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can// srid gsum skye 'jig med pa'i dngos// shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku// dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ rjes spyi dang mthun/ gtor ma rgyas pa la dga' na/ sgrub thabs chen mo rnams su shes par bya'o// 'di'i rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra la/ thugs kyi rjes gnang phyag mtshan bstim pa nyid yin no// sgrub thabs kun las ches bsdus pa// blo dman dga' ba bskyed pa'i gzhi// bskyed rim snying po nyung ngu'i ngag /'di yang 'gro la phan phyir brtsams// dus 'khor lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs bstan pa'i le tshan no// ༈ /dus 'khor lhan skyes kyi rjes gnang gi zin bris nyung gsal bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ dus 'khor lhan skyes kyi rjes gnang la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ stegs bu'i dbus su maṇḍal tshom bu gcig pa dang mchod gtor/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril nang mchod sogs bsham/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sgrub thabs rin 'byung ltar grub rjes/

tshom bu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrāḥphaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ tshom bu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis dus 'khor lhan skyes su gyur pa ni sogs nas/ kṣa sngon po rnams su gyur/ mchod pas bsang sbyang byin brlabs la/ oṃ shrī kā la tsa kra sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ stong nyid snying rje'i sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma bsang sbyang byin brlab sgrub thabs ltar phul/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul bar dmigs te bzlas pa cung zad bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral du 'khod par/ sems bskyed gsal btab pas mtshams sbyar te/ de la gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la rgyud sde chen po bzhir dbye ba las/ rgyud sde thams cad kyi mthar thug pa rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi yang rtse/ rgya che ba gnyis su med pa dpal mchog gi dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo la/ bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi dngos bstan mchog sgrub pa dang*/ las rgyas pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor ji snyed cig gsungs pa las/ 'dir de thams cad kyi gzhi'am rtsa ba lta bur gyur pa bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po dus zhabs pas mdzad pa dang rjes su 'brel par slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi cho ga sgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la/ thog mar rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇḍal phul/ gsol 'debs nas brtsams te rjes gnang gi chings khro phu ba'i lugs kyi rjes gnang gi cho ga spyi dang 'dra ba yin te/ kho bos byas pa'i ni ri ti pa'i lugs kyi byams pa'i rjes gnang la lha'i mtshan/ mngon rtogs/ sngags rnams kha spos pas kyang legs par grub po// gsum pa ni/ tshom bu'i lha la mchod bstod/

nongs bshags/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs kyis gnas drug bsrung*/ bsngo smon shis brjod spyi ltar bya'o// zhes pa'ang bya bral pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos zin bris su btab pa dge legs su gyur cig/ //sarba dā maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
